title: Premium Billing Accounts — Credit, Refund and Closure Schedule
content:
Premium credits, refunds of credit balances and account closures on Premium Billing Accounts follow the per-arrangement values below.

- **Refund minimum** — USD; credit balances below this amount on a closed account are not refunded but written off.
- **Refund method** — original payment method means refund to the method of the latest payment; credit next invoice means applied to the next group invoice, refunded only on closure.
- **Refund issue time** — business days after the credit is booked within which a refund is issued.
- **Termination credit basis** — credit on voluntary termination: full months after termination means premium billed for coverage months after the termination month is credited; no partial-month refund.
- **Credit transfer allowed** — whether a credit balance may be applied to past-due premium on another open account of the same customer before any refund.
- **Closure requires zero balance** — whether an account can be closed only once its balance is 0.00 after credits, refunds and write-offs.

| Arrangement | Refund minimum (USD) | Refund method | Refund issue time (business days) | Termination credit basis | Credit transfer allowed | Closure requires zero balance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly | 5.00 | original payment method | 10 | full months after termination | yes | yes |
| Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly | 5.00 | original payment method | 10 | full months after termination | yes | yes |
| Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill | 5.00 | original payment method | 10 | full months after termination | yes | yes |
| Cascade Individual Annual Prepay | 5.00 | original payment method | 10 | full months after termination | yes | yes |
| Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly | 5.00 | original payment method | 10 | full months after termination | no | yes |
| Cascade Group List Bill | 25.00 | credit next invoice | 15 | full months after termination | no | yes |
| Cascade Group Self-Administered Bill | 25.00 | credit next invoice | 15 | full months after termination | no | yes |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical balances on a closed account).** On an individual arrangement a credit balance of 5.00 is refunded and one of 4.99 is written off; on a group arrangement 25.00 is refunded and 24.99 is written off.
